|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (version 3 of 3). It is the current text. * '''Original''' ([[Son Of Skywalker (V)]]): the card image at official release (29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, with the PC's Set 24 errata and fixes. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters ‘hit’ by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The double space after “characters.” (before “Immune to attrition < 4.”) became a single space. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Son Of Skywalker (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>, page 2, file created 2 February 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters 'hit' by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin's Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Son Of Skywalker”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Son Of Skywalker (V)]] (published 30 December 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Son Of Skywalker]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the errata card image (6 August 2025, on 7 August 2025)<ref name="ht-9496153">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/949615388238cb4257bda7343316b6d6df5cd56c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Light/large/sonofskywalker.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/949615388238cb4257bda7343316b6d6df5cd56c 9496153] “Set 25 images plus a small fix”, 6 August 2025, on 7 August 2025. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> prints: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During battle, characters ‘hit’ by Luke may not fire weapons. May deploy Anakin’s Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If a battle just initiated at same site, unless a vehicle here, may target a Dark Jedi here; for remainder of battle, exclude all other characters. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' The words of the game text are unchanged. The round icon at the right edge of the game-text box (below the two icons) was redrawn. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
